newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 18.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 18.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$16.90 (+0.08)

BHP released its monthly production report, which showed steel despatches rose two percent in the ten months to March, copper concentrate production rose 38 percent, gas production fell six percent, coal production rose nine percent and iron ore production rose six percent.

Cultus Petroleum Managing Director Don Beard told Reuters late on Thursday he expected Cultus to more than double first half profits in the second half year and that he expected Cultus' market capitalisation to breach A$1 billion in the next couple of years.

Tyre maker Bridgestone Australia Ltd said on Thursday that its first half result to June 30, 1997 was likely to be below the result recorded a year ago. Bridgestone said softer retail conditions than at the same time last year, hot weather in some Australian states and heavy rains in others had affected its operations for the quarter to March 31, 1997.

Molson Cos Ltd could be considering buying back a 20 percent stake in Molson Breweries it had previously sold in a bid to return to its brewing roots. Analysts speculated on Thursday that Molson Cos chairman Eric Molson would try to buy back the 20 percent stake from Miller Brewing Co rather than seek Miller's approval for a proposed partnership with arch rival Adolf Coors Co to manage Coors products in Canada.
